description: Batch text embeddings via the configured llama-server's /v1/embeddings (requires --embeddings and an embedding-capable model). One vector per input, order preserved. Fully local; credential only when the server runs with --api-key.

input.description: Texts to embed, one vector returned per input, order preserved.

model.description: Model name passed through to the server. llama-server embeds with its loaded model regardless; the field is echoed for parity with the other providers.

embeddings.description: One embedding per input, in input order.
